_comment: Instance data of helpers/topic-sources.cjs (UserPromptSubmit). A prompt that matches a topic's prompt_patterns (regex, case-insensitive) gets every source file of the topic listed; a source is a file or a folder (recursive, text files). 'also' names sources a path cannot point at (a grep over ledgers). Add one entry per topic the operator asks summaries about. The decision register named with every hit is the one in decision-register.json (its `register`).

topics.name: shopping
topics.also: purchase decisions in the project ledgers
